question: Can frozen DINO features predict S2M2 high-error/artifact/flicker regions?
inputs: optional low-res S2M2 disparity/error scalar maps for ablation labels only

target_masks.s2m2_high_error: abs(s2m2_disp - gt_disp) >= 3 px on valid pixels
target_masks.boundary_artifact: GT edge p80/p90 intersect high disparity error
target_masks.flicker: same-pixel temporal error variation above clip q75
target_masks.motion_mismatch: same-pixel temporal motion mismatch above clip q75
target_masks.validity_stress: low valid-pixel regions / masks as diagnostic, not positive error labels

train_sequences: candidate clips excluding one clean and one stress sequence
split.rule: sequence-level split only; never split adjacent frames across train/test

storage_safe_features.default: run DINO on selected frames only and keep derived CSV metrics
storage_safe_features.if_needed: save compressed patch/token features for selected clips only, e.g. npz float16/PCA tokens
storage_safe_features.never_default: no full-resolution dense DINO feature cache over all 22,950 frames
